metadata.title: Remoulade Sauce
metadata.description: This mayonnaise is sometimes called French Tartar Sauce in the US.  The addition of hard boiled eggs, chives and capers make this sauce more substantial and can also be thinned out and used as a mayonnaise sauce.

nodes.plm_action: prepare a cream sauce in a separate bowl by adding some cream and the cooked scallops and some parsley and salt and pepper to taste
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man standing in a professional kitchen while demonstrating how to make a recipe. He uses several ingredients from the plates in front of him to demonstrate.
The man has white chef's coat on. He is bald, with short sideburns. He has a black beard and mustache. He is wearing glasses and is slightly overweight.
The kitchen features an industrial style stove in the background. The stoves have multiple burners and knobs. There are pots and pans behind the chef. The counters are stainless steel, with several bowls on them. The work surface has a white cloth covering it. The plates are white and the bowls are silver. There is a clear bottle with a large white cap. One of the bowls has a hand mixer in it. Some of the food is being prepared in the bowls.
The man is in front of the camera, he's looking at it and speaking. There are two white plates and two bowls in front of him. He grabs a plate with his left hand, he then uses both hands to lift it up. He then throws it down onto the worktop with his right hand. He picks up a knife with his right hand and puts it down on the worktop on the left. He picks up the bowl with his right hand and puts it on a plate. He picks up a lemon and squeezes some juice over his right hand into the bowl. He drops the lemon on the worktop and picks up the hand mixer with his left hand. He then puts the mixer in the bowl with his right hand and grabs the bowl with his left hand. The bowl is filled with the food. He grabs the whisk in the bowl with his right hand and begins mixing the food. After he finishes, he grabs the bowl with his right hand and puts it down on the white worktop in front of him.  He grabs a plate and a white cloth and then adds the food to the plate with the white cloth. He repeats this three times.

summary.brief: The chef mixes mayonnaise with herbs, anchovies, egg and seasonings to make remoulade sauce, thins it with cream, and portions it onto plates.
summary.detailed: A bald chef in a white coat stands at a stainless‑steel counter, starts with homemade mayonnaise in a bowl and folds in chopped parsley, minced garlic, capers, anchovies, a finely chopped hard‑boiled egg, scallions (or chives), black pepper, salt and lemon juice, then twirls the mixture to combine. After tasting, he adds a little more lemon juice, salt and garlic to balance the flavor, pours in a splash of cream to loosen the texture, gives the sauce a final stir, and uses a white cloth to scoop and place portions onto a plate, repeating the portioning three times before tasting and commenting on the finished sauce.

action.detailed: Combine mayonnaise with parsley, garlic, capers, anchovies, chopped hard‑boiled egg, scallions, pepper, salt and lemon juice, stir, taste and adjust the seasoning, add a splash of cream, give a final stir, and portion the sauce onto plates.
action.actor: A bald male chef wearing a white chef’s coat

He begins by gesturing with his left hand as he talks, then picks up a large metal bowl that contains a yellow, batter‑like mixture. He holds the bowl up for the camera while continuing his explanation of the ingredients. After a short pause, he puts the bowl down onto a white sheet of paper on the countertop and resumes speaking, occasionally leaning forward or shifting his stance as he gestures.

action.detailed: Lift the metal bowl filled with the yellow mixture, hold it up for the camera while speaking, then set it onto a white paper on the countertop and continue gesturing.
action.actor: a bald, bearded male chef wearing a white chef's coat

The video shows a cook in a white chef coat making a food dish.
He is preparing the dish on a stainless steel counter, surrounded by pots and pans, and has a large, stainless steel mixing bowl in front of him. The silver bowl is filled with some food that the chef is combining with other ingredients. The man grabs an egg and squeezes it on top of some vegetables, then adds garlic and lemon juice. The man also adds flour and mixes the contents of the silver bowl with a spatula. The man then makes about four balls of food from it.

summary.brief: The chef mixes mayonnaise with parsley, garlic, capers, anchovies, chopped hard‑boiled egg, scallions, pepper, salt, lemon juice, and a splash of cream to create remoulade sauce.
summary.detailed: The chef begins with a bowl of mayonnaise, adds chopped parsley, minced garlic, capers, and anchovy fillets, then folds in finely chopped hard‑boiled egg. He sprinkles chopped scallions (or chives), a pinch of black pepper, a pinch of salt, and squeezes fresh lemon juice into the bowl, giving the mixture a quick twirl. He tastes the sauce with a spoon, adjusts the flavor by adding a little more lemon, salt, and garlic, and finally whiskes in a small amount of cream for a lighter texture before plating the finished remoulade.

action.detailed: Combine mayonnaise with parsley, garlic, capers, anchovies, finely chopped hard‑boiled egg, scallions, pepper, salt and lemon juice, stir, taste and adjust, then whisk in a splash of cream before plating.
action.actor: the bald chef in a white coat

nodes.plm_caption:
A chef is demonstrating how to make a pasta salad. A kitchen can be seen in the background. The chef makes a large bowl and adds several ingredients to it.
The chef begins by holding up a metal bowl. He pulls a small bowl from the bottom of the metal bowl. He then sets the metal bowl down to his right and sets down the small bowl he was holding to his left. He then picks up another plate. The plate has green and brown things on it, as well as a white substance. He puts some of the brown and green items into the metal bowl. He then picks up a knife and starts to chop the brown and green items into small pieces. The camera zooms in on the chopped items, which he then pours into the metal bowl. He wipes off his knife. He then removes a glass from his pocket and uses it to separate the white substance from the other ingredients. The white substance is then separated into a plate and the plate of white stuff is then moved to the metal bowl. The plate that was being held by the chef now has chopped green things on it. He puts the plate with the chopped green thing in it into the metal bowl, then he then uses a lemon to remove the juice from it. Finally, he grabs a grater. Throughout the video, the chef talks to the camera, even when he is not speaking.

summary.brief: The chef gathers and mixes ingredients in a bowl to make a remoulade‑style sauce.
summary.detailed: The chef lifts a large metal bowl, pulls a smaller bowl out of its base and places both on the counter. He then takes a plate that holds green herbs, brown capers (or similar bits) and a white condiment, and moves some of the green and brown items into the metal bowl. Using a knife he chops those ingredients into small pieces, then wipes the blade clean. He pulls a glass from his pocket and uses it like a strainer to separate the white condiment from the plate, transferring it onto a separate plate and then into the metal bowl. After that he squeezes fresh lemon juice over the mixture, and finally picks up a grater—likely to zest the lemon—before the segment ends, all while commenting on the process.

action.detailed: Combine the chopped green and brown ingredients with the separated white condiment in the bowl, squeeze lemon juice over the mixture, and grate lemon zest into it.
action.actor: The bald chef wearing a white chef’s coat

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a shot of a chef in a white chef jacket whisking a bowl of ingredients with a silver whisk. The individual is then preparing and plating the food. The environment is a clean, professional kitchen.

summary.brief: The chef mixes a white sauce, seasons it, and then plates it together with seasoned mashed potatoes.
summary.detailed: In a professional kitchen the bald chef wearing a white coat whiskes a yellow‑white sauce in a large stainless‑steel bowl, squeezes fresh lemon juice into the mixture, adds a pinch of salt and continues stirring until the sauce is smooth. He tastes the sauce, adjusts the seasoning, and ladles the finished sauce onto a plate. He then picks up a bowl of cooked potatoes, places some on another plate, wipes his hands on a towel, seasons the potatoes with salt, and uses a potato masher to mash them in the bowl, cleaning the masher as needed. Finally he plates the mashed potatoes beside the sauced plate while continuing his commentary.

action.detailed: Whisk the sauce in a bowl, add lemon juice and salt, stir until smooth, taste and adjust seasoning, ladle the sauce onto a plate, then scoop potatoes into another bowl, season with salt, mash them with a masher, and plate the mashed potatoes beside the sauce.
action.actor: the bald chef wearing a white coat

nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a man cooking in a professional kitchen while explaining the ingredients he uses. It cuts to different dishes at various times.
The man begins by gesturing to the camera with his hands. He holds a bowl with a yellow mixture in it, which he moves around on a counter. He grabs another bowl, then a small white bowl and then a flat white plate. He mixes some green herbs and sprinkles them over the contents of a second bowl. The video ends with the man grabbing a third bowl. The man is wearing a white chef's coat with buttons down the front and a round logo on the right of his chest.

summary.brief: The chef adds herbs, lemon zest and seasonings to a yellow mixture, gives it a quick stir, then wipes his knife and walks away.
summary.detailed: In a commercial kitchen the bald chef in a white coat stands at a stainless‑steel counter holding a large silver bowl that contains a yellow sauce. He moves the bowl a short distance, then picks up a small white plate holding chopped green herbs and sprink­les the herbs into the bowl. He follows by adding a tiny bowl of lemon zest, a pinch of chopped green onions, and a shake of salt and pepper, sometimes pressing the herbs through a small strainer. After the ingredients are incorporated he gives the mixture a brief stir, sets the plate and a utensil down, drops the bowl onto a white cutting board, wipes the blade of his knife on a white napkin, and walks off the frame to the left.

action.brief: Add herbs and seasonings to bowl
action.detailed: Pick up the plates and small bowls holding chopped herbs, lemon zest, green onions, and salt‑pepper, sprinkle or pour them into the large bowl of yellow sauce, give the mixture a quick stir, then wipe the knife and walk away.
action.actor: the chef, a bald man wearing a white chef’s coat

nodes.plm_caption:
A chef is shown preparing a dish in a professional kitchen. He shows and discusses ingredients before beginning to prepare the dish. He squeezes lemon juice into the ingredients. The video is sped up, with the only sound being the chef's discussion.
At the start of the video, the chef holds a large knife, with one hand on the handle and one hand with the blade on a chopping board. With the knife, he places several ingredients into the board then out of shot,  and wipes the knife clean before setting it down.

Using one hand, he picks up a stainless steel sieve, with the other hand holding a plate of ingredients which he pours into the sieve. Then, with one hand holding the sieve and the other hand holding the plate of ingredients he slides the sieve onto the table then lifts the plate and transfers it to a bowl and sets it down.

Then he picks up a plate with greens on it and holds that up before transferring them to a bowl which he also lifts from the table.

Using his left hand, he squeezes a lemon in his hand and into the bowl.

The final shot is of the large bowl, which shows the final ingredients.

summary.brief: The chef chops ingredients, strains them, then mixes greens, feta, seasoning and lemon juice into a bowl.
summary.detailed: The chef first slices brown pieces on a white cutting board with a knife, wipes the blade and places the cut pieces on a plate. He lifts a stainless‑steel sieve, holds the plate above it, and pours the chopped pieces through the sieve onto the countertop, then slides the sieve aside and transfers the strained contents into a large mixing bowl. He adds a plate of green vegetables to the same bowl, opens a bag of seasoning and sprinkles it in, grates a ball of feta cheese directly into the bowl, and seasons the mixture with a pinch of salt and pepper. Finally, he squeezes fresh lemon juice from a lemon held in his left hand into the bowl and gives the bowl a quick twirl to combine everything, revealing the finished sauce.

action.detailed: Place the chopped pieces, greens, feta, seasoning, salt, pepper and lemon juice into a bowl and toss the mixture together.
action.actor: the chef wearing a white coat

summary.brief: The chef whisks a bowl, seasons it with lemon juice and salt, tastes it, then plates the sauce while handling a towel and a pan.
summary.detailed: A bald chef in a white coat stands at the stainless‑steel counter and continuously whiskes a large silver bowl with a metal whisk. He squeezes fresh lemon juice directly into the bowl, adds a pinch of salt, and keeps stirring until the mixture looks uniform. He briefly brings a spoon to his mouth to taste a drop of the sauce, then wipes his hands with a white towel. He places several white plates on the work surface, transfers the sauce from the bowl onto the plates, folds the towel in half, lifts a nearby pan and pours its remaining contents onto another plate, and finishes the segment by cleaning his hand with the towel.

action.detailed: Whisk the contents of the large bowl, squeeze lemon juice into it, sprinkle salt, stir until smooth, taste a small amount, wipe your hands with the towel, place plates on the counter, pour the sauce onto the plates, fold the towel, and pour any remaining liquid from the pan onto a plate.
action.actor: The bald chef wearing a white chef's coat and a beard

nodes.plm_caption: A man wearing a white chef's uniform is in a professional kitchen and he is making potatoes. There is a large stove behind the man with many different pots stacked on top of each other. The man picks up a silver bowl and puts some of the potatoes in a plate. He cleans his hands on a towel, picks up a salt bottle, and puts salt in the potatoes before he picks up the bowl again and he mixes the potatoes with a potato masher. There are large silver cooking pots and pans in the kitchen and a stainless steel stove with a stove burner in front of the man. Then the man cleans his hands on a towel and picks up another white plate and takes a small portion of potatoes on it. After that, he cleans the potatoes off the potato masher and puts the potato masher into the potatoes in the silver bowl. He then puts the plate of potatoes on the counter in front of the bowl. The man gestures with his hands as he talks. He talks the entire video while working in the kitchen. The lighting is bright and the man is easily visible in this video.

summary.brief: The chef seasons, mixes, and plates the remoulade sauce.
summary.detailed: The chef lifts the large silver mixing bowl containing the creamy remoulade and scoops a portion onto a white plate. He wipes his hands on a towel, sprinkles a pinch of salt and squeezes a bit of lemon juice over the plated sauce. He then returns to the bowl, adds a splash of cream, followed by two pours of almond milk, and uses a whisk (or potato masher) to blend everything until smooth. After cleaning his hands again, he plates another small amount of the sauce, places the plates on the countertop, and continues explaining the preparation while gesturing toward the food. The bright professional kitchen shows stainless‑steel appliances, a large stove, and hanging cookware in the background.

action.detailed: Season the sauce with salt and lemon, add cream and almond milk, whisk it until smooth, and plate the finished remoulade.
action.actor: The chef, a bald man with a beard wearing a white chef coat

nodes.plm_caption:
This is a good quality, 1 minute video of a cook in a chef's suit adding milk to a mixing bowl. He pours the milk twice from a plastic bottle, adds a dash of salt in from a bowl then whisks it in with a whisk. The cooking environment is in full view, a large stove, lots of pans and many shelves holding cooking pots and pans behind him. The counter in front of him has various ingredients for the dish, like chopped vegetables and sauces in bowls, a plate with a garnish. The cook is standing at a white surface, facing slightly left. He has a bald head, a short beard and mustache and a round logo on the left breast of his coat.
The man picks up the milk in his right hand, holds a mixing bowl in his left hand and then holds the bowl firmly. He pours the milk in front of him in a stream. He sets the milk bottle down, picks up a bowl with salt and adds it to the milk. He sets the bowl of salt down. He picks up the milk bottle again, pours some more milk from the bottle. He sets it down, picks up the whisk and holds it in his right hand. He sets his left hand on the edge of the bowl and whisks with a single, continuous motion. He tilts the bowl in a left to right motion to the right in front of him, stops whisking and then tilts the bowl again.

summary.brief: The chef pours a white liquid, adds salt, and whiskes the mixture in a bowl.
summary.detailed: Holding a clear plastic bottle of white liquid in his right hand and a metal mixing bowl in his left, the chef pours a stream of the liquid into the bowl, sets the bottle down, grabs a small bowl of salt and sprinklies a pinch into the bowl, returns the salt bowl, picks up the bottle again and adds a second pour of the liquid. He then places the bottle aside, lifts a whisk with his right hand, steadies the bowl with his left, and whiskes the contents in a continuous motion, tilting the bowl left‑to‑right, pausing briefly, and tilting it again as he creates a smooth mixture.

action.detailed: Pour the white liquid and a pinch of salt into the bowl, then whisk the mixture continuously while tilting the bowl side‑to‑side.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to either of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   A video can match neither, one, or both. Be strict — when in doubt,
   say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
